decision: Classify the 370.346M XRP reported outside the 13-wallet attribution set as strongly supported BitGo custody reallocation, not verified market supply, sale or exchange deposit.
rationale: SEC prospectus identifies BitGo as primary custodian and states all XRP initially held in BitGo custody accounts.
SEC prospectus says 100% of XRP was in cold storage as of 2026-10-30.
Q-Eternal reports the 2026-10-22 reorganization moved XRP between BitGo-initialized 2-of-3 multisig accounts.
Q-Eternal reports post-transfer balances align closely with SEC disclosed tranches.
Bithomp pages opened for nine destination accounts show BitGo initialization wallet as activator and multisig control.
limitations: Destination beneficial ownership is not directly disclosed.
The 600,000 XRP advance-funding subscriber tranche remains unmapped in the ten-destination table.
The tracker balance plus outflow total exceeds the SEC closing figure by 200,137.78 XRP.
The tracker JSON and rendered page use different validated ledger cutoffs.
Two later tagged inflows totaling 9.07M XRP to the cash-purchased-tranche destination remain unattributed.
